description: Q46: the systemd user units for the parallel OpenCode V2 stack (server, its GitHub token drop-in, and the permission detector). The V2 config root is regenerated by scripts/derive-v2-config.py and V1 files are never touched, so these three single files are the only authorable content outside git. The drop-in directory must already exist (file_create never creates directories). Run with --allow-root ~/.config/systemd/user.
